mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete rebuilt Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 engine typically costs between £4,200 and £6,500 for supply only [EM-QUOTE]. Used units start from around £1,500. Reconditioned units range from £3,000 to £5,000. Prices vary based on the specific 204PT engine code and supplier.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump or cooling failure in a Discovery Sport P250?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include unexplained coolant loss, a sweet smell from the engine bay, or dashboard warning lights indicating low coolant levels. Unusual engine noises or knocking due to overheating. Reduced performance or limp mode activation. Steam or visible leaks under the vehicle after driving.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Discovery Sport P250?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. The Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 is a high-value premium SUV with current market values ranging from £18,000 to over £45,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A rebuilt engine cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's total value. It preserves the car's towing capability, refinement, and resale value. Upgraded rebuilt units address known factory cooling component weaknesses.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 engine supply and fit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 engine replacement typically takes 3 to 5 working days. Removal and preparation of the old unit takes 1-2 days. Fitting, calibration, and 48V MHEV system testing of the new rebuilt engine takes 2-3 days. Nationwide collection and delivery are arranged by the specialist.

mainEntity.name: Do rebuilt P250 engines retain the 48V mild-hybrid (MHEV) functionality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, reputable specialists rebuilding a Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 engine ensure full compatibility with the 48V mild-hybrid architecture. The integrated starter-generator (ISG) and associated electrical components are tested and calibrated. All MHEV software maps are retained or updated to factory specifications. This ensures seamless stop-start operation and torque-fill performance.

historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: Launched as the performance-oriented petrol variant of the L550 Discovery Sport, the P250 pairs versatile seven-seat practicality with a potent 2.0-litre turbocharged Ingenium petrol engine, offering a refined alternative to the diesel lineup.

milestones.description: 204PT (2.0L Petrol), 249PS (246bhp), introduced to the Discovery Sport range, replacing older Si4/240 badging with a refined turbocharged setup and improved thermal management.
Introduction of the 48V Mild Hybrid Electric Vehicle (MHEV) system to the P250 range, improving fuel efficiency and providing seamless torque-fill during acceleration.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

problems.h4: Water Pump & Cooling System Vulnerability - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 204PT Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: Plastic impeller water pumps and coolant crossover components can degrade under repeated heat cycles, leading to coolant loss and potential overheating if not addressed promptly.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Coolant flush and replacement with updated water pump assembly
repairOptions.longevity: Highly suitable for minor leaks before overheating occurs

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt 2.0L petrol with upgraded cooling components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if coolant loss has caused severe overheating and warped components

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 holds a current UK market value of £18,000 to £45,000+ depending on specification and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. At this valuation, a rebuilt engine replacement cost represents a small fraction of the vehicle's total value, making professional replacement highly viable to preserve its premium status.
problems.recommendation: Proactive inspection and replacement of the water pump is a highly recommended, low-cost preventative measure. If overheating has already occurred, a full rebuilt engine replacement is the safest and most reliable solution to protect your investment.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt 204PT Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Chain Stretch - Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 Performance Vulnerability
problems.rootCause: Timing chain tensioners can experience wear over time, leading to chain stretch and a distinct rattling noise on cold starts.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Inspection and replacement of chain, tensioners, and guides
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if the engine block and internals are undamaged

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt engine with upgraded tensioner components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if catastrophic failure has occurred or the block is compromised

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Given the £18,000-£45,000+ value band of the Land Rover Discovery Sport P250, addressing timing chain wear early is trivial compared to the vehicle's worth. Ignoring it risks catastrophic failure, making a rebuilt engine the necessary fallback if damage is done.
problems.recommendation: If caught early, a specialist timing chain kit replacement is the most cost-effective route. However, if the engine has suffered catastrophic failure due to neglected chain wear, investing in a fully rebuilt unit is the only way to guarantee long-term reliability.
